title: Week been such an up and down emotionally. Watching the Grammys, the love for Kobe, made me hopeful, but now we close with Brexit and the GOP cover up
summary: Week been such an up and down emotionally. Watching the Grammys, the love for Kobe, made me hopeful, but now we close with Brexit and the GOP cover up of Trump's crimes on the same day. This will be a day that will have ramifications for decades
